name: Character Maker
original_description:
Describe a hero, a villain or a mascot and get an original character: a portrait, a full-body figure or a sheet with several views.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the character in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The image opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For writers, game masters and game developers.

Limitations: original characters from a description; it does not draw existing characters from films, games or comics, or real people. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
summary_ja: 説明文からオリジナルキャラクターの肖像・全身像・複数方向のシートを生成し、MegaScenesに保存する。
limitations_ja: MegaScenesへのサインインと生成前の確認が必要と説明。既存の映画・ゲーム・漫画キャラクター、実在人物、成人向け内容は対象外と記載。動作・料金・画像の品質は未検証。
details_ja: 詳細ページの名称はCharacter Maker、アプリ欄はCharacter Maker by MegaScenes。別のCharacter Creatorとは表示名・提供元・詳細ページが異なる。
official_name_basis: ChatGPTのプラグイン詳細画面に表示された名称
description_scope: ChatGPT詳細画面の提供元の英語説明。
review: 詳細画面の説明と情報欄を確認。インストール・実機能の検証は行っていない。
